exposure: Celiac disease (CD) status (untreated vs. after diagnosis/gluten-free diet)
outcome: Patient satisfaction with information from healthcare professionals
cohort: 493 celiac women who participated in a digital survey via the Italian Celiac Association's website.
finding: Untreated celiac disease was associated with higher rates of miscarriages, anemia in pregnancy, and low birth weight, with improvements observed after diagnosis and adherence to a gluten-free diet.
